name: Lilith Abel Bindernagel
original_name: リリス・アーベル・ビンダーナーゲル
source:
Faction: Asmodian
Skill: The Black Snake's Safeguard (Kuro Hebi no Shugo), Unleashed "Mega Miasma Gun" (Gentei Kahiou "Mega Shouki Hou"), The Black Serpent Protection (Kuro Daija no Shougo), Witch's Present (Majo Kara no Okurimono), Catch me Before the Wave (Namiyori Saki Ni Tsukamae te), Ninjutsu: Dragon Dance
Artist: [url=/s2661]Asahi[/url]
Cards: [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/e918284415235d71e5ce11df16c94f1f.png]AS 2 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/c925f939fa00f898e34eea7be79152ef.png]AS 3 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/aa23e41ee746f68b63c9cba015be873a.png]AS 4 Stars EX[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/f4acb5adef43191b87d4ce61d2ccf6a8.png]AS 4 Stars EX[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/d9a41b0ec526a225efd49ccff5199c14.png]AS 5 Stars EX[/url]
History:
She is a high-ranking demoness whose life span is said to be tens of thousands of years, and has become the second Lilith after her grandmother.
Her grandmother was the legendary witch Lilith (same name), who was known and feared by all the inhabitants of the demon world and was said to be able to avoid a distance of 300 kilometers, and even drove away the old gods to the Otherworld. The Lilith of the modern age came to the human world to train as a warrior. Her talent is the best in the world of magic, but she is still inexperienced. She was often told, by her grandmother, before her death not to cry.
She explores the Human World in order to learn about the things she wants to protect, together with her friend Beririku a currently shrunken down ancient dragon, which knew her grandmother.
